discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators
subfield: Condensed matter physics / topological quantum materials
motivation: Kane (with Mele) showed that spin-orbit coupling can produce a time-reversal-invariant Z2 topological phase, a new state of electronic matter with protected helical edge and surface states. Molenkamp's group gave the first experimental proof: quantized edge conduction of the quantum spin Hall state in HgTe quantum wells (2007). Hasan's group used spin-resolved ARPES to discover the three-dimensional topological insulators (Bi-Sb, Bi2Se3 family), directly imaging the Dirac surface states and their spin-momentum locking. This interplay of theory, materials design and spectroscopy has reshaped condensed-matter physics. It extended band theory with topology and started a worldwide field that now includes the quantum anomalous Hall effect in magnetic topological insulators, Weyl semimetals and topological superconductivity. It also opens routes to dissipationless electronics and fault-tolerant quantum devices. The results have been widely reproduced and are general in scope, and they have opened a whole field.
